supported_operating_region.summary: Supported only over the cited 25 degC electrical characterization region: gate_source_voltage_magnitude 4.5 to 10 V; drain_current_magnitude 5 to 10 A.

numeric_bounds.conditions: Cited threshold and RDS(on) gate-bias conditions

known_omissions: AC, transient, noise, thermal, and package-parasitic behavior are outside this DC-only conveyor package.
Temperature dependence and self-heating are not modelled; the electrical region is limited to the cited nominal-temperature data.
Catalog parametrics were used only as initial guesses or F1 fallback constraints and are not datasheet citations.

F2 evidence did not qualify; staged as F1: mosfet F2 gate failed: drain_current worst relative error 7.4843 exceeds gate 0.2; drain_current RMS relative error 2.7770 exceeds gate 0.12; rds_on worst relative error 0.3573 exceeds gate 0.2; rds_on RMS relative error 0.1806 exceeds gate 0.12

Additional plots for on-resistance, body-diode, safe-operating-area, power-rating, and thermal-impedance characteristics were not digitized; output, transfer, capacitance, and gate-charge plots were usable and extracted.
Gate-threshold behavior is not covered by this F1 package; the supported region is limited to cited nominal-temperature RDS(on) targets.
